newsitem.title: INDIA: New India ministers to take oath on Thursday.
newsitem.headline: New India ministers to take oath on Thursday.

text.p: Indian President Shankar Dayal Sharma will induct new ministers into Prime Minister Inder Kumar Gujral's government on Thursday at 6 p.m. (1230 GMT), the president's spokesman said.
The swearing-in ceremony had initially been set for Wednesday at 7:30 p.m. (1400), but at the request of some of the prospective ministers was delayed.
Former finance minister P. Chidambaram and three others from his Tamil Maanila Congress party were expected to return to their posts.
Jaipal Reddy, spokesman for Gujral's Janata Dal party, was expected to receive a cabinet berth, and Maqbool Dar was to take the oath as junior home (interior) minister.
